race.title: Margaret Long Memorial Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: THEY'RE CHANCERS has made a bright start to his career, winning his sole outing in bumpers and beaten only by a fellow well-bred type at Kelso on his hurdling debut. He is fancied to open his hurdles account with improvement to come, Ar Ais Aris next on the list ahead of Baron du Brizais . THEY'RE CHANCERS (IRE) AR AIS ARIS (IRE) BARON DU BRIZAIS (FR)
race.bettingForecast: They're Chancers (3/1), Coconut Man (7/2), Baron Du Brizais (9/2), Galatrona (6/1), Ar Ais Aris (6/1), Blofeld (12/1), Katagat (12/1), Absence Of Ego (20/1), Cushendun (20/1), Billy Bob Junior (25/1), Frompillartopost (33/1), A Merry Walk (33/1), Gili Island (66/1), Mymatemac (100/1), Marble Sky (150/1)
